name: nuytek-harness-observatory
description: Captures Claude Code session, agent and cost telemetry into a local append-only store.

retentionDays.title: Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: Days to keep captured files before they are pruned.

harnessProfile.title: Harness profile
harnessProfile.description: Also capture harness-specific fields (guard, skillsInjected, status, parserVersion, estimates).

anomalyDelegationCostUsd.title: Delegation cost anomaly (USD)
anomalyDelegationCostUsd.description: Flag a delegation tree whose estimated cost exceeds this amount.

anomalyCacheRatioMin.title: Cache ratio anomaly (minimum)
anomalyCacheRatioMin.description: Flag a tree or session whose cache ratio is below this value (0 to 1).

anomalyDeniesPerSessionMax.title: Denies per session anomaly
anomalyDeniesPerSessionMax.description: Flag a session with more tool denies than this.
